claimed_strengths: NIM card live since 08/20/2026 at build.nvidia.com/moonshotai/kimi-k3
moonshotai/kimi-k3 in NIM API model list today (verified)

files.note.txt: NIM has the card and lists the model. The weights are public on HF (moonshotai/Kimi-K3). 5+ HF providers serve it. Our herd route never used NIM (it used Pollinations/OpenRouter), so its death says nothing about NIM.

claimed_strengths: NVIDIA forums document 404s from NIM kimi-k3 endpoint (Aug 2026)

files.note.txt: Multiple forum users report the NIM endpoint returning 404, 429 soft-locks lasting 24h, and degraded responses. DeepSeek also 404d at the same time, pointing to NVIDIA infra issues. From the caller's view the NIM endpoint is unreliable.

claimed_strengths: NIM uses moonshotai/kimi-k3, HF uses moonshotai/Kimi-K3, local alias kimi-k3-nim was never real
wrong ID gives 404 which looks like model broken

files.note.txt: Three ID formats across surfaces. Our own agent misdiagnosed a 401 as a routing failure in Sep 2026. vLLM needs kimi_k3 parser not kimi_k2 (else empty responses). Config/credential failures get misread as model failures.

hard_constraints: ground claims in the attached notes
separate model existence from endpoint reliability
spec: Question: Is Kimi K3 actually broken on NVIDIA NIM, and what is the correct way to call it? Three positions: (1) NIM is fine, failures transient; (2) NIM hosted endpoint genuinely unreliable, use HF providers; (3) reputation is mostly wrong model IDs. Judge which best fits the evidence.
